page.title: History backfill
page.description: QRadar's past, read once so baselines can learn at once; the window is the history backfill setting. Old data is used for learning only, never judged. Times are UTC.
page.couldNotShow: The history backfill could not be shown.
page.forbidden: Your role cannot read it (permission <perm>read:history_backfill</perm>). Nothing was changed.
page.couldNotLoad: The history backfill could not be loaded.
page.unreachable: The backend may be unreachable. Nothing was changed. Check that it is running, then try again.
page.noConsoleHelp: The history backfill is decided and read per enabled console, so there is nothing to show. Register and enable a console, then reload this page.

line.undecided: History backfill: not decided. Nothing is read from QRadar's past.
line.no: History backfill: No, history is not read. Recorded by {by} on <time></time>.
line.yes: History backfill: Yes{days}. Recorded by {by} on <time></time>.
line.startAsked: Read history now was asked by {by} on <time></time>.
line.stopAsked: Stop reading was asked by {by} on <time></time>.

decision.needsPermission: Changing the answer needs the permission <perm>admin:history_backfill</perm>.
decision.forbidden: Not changed. Your role cannot change the history backfill (permission {permission}).
decision.failed: Not changed. The request could not be completed. Check that the backend is reachable, then try again.

confirm.yes: This records Yes{days}. At its next collection each family reads the days before its first live data: source volume, catch-all senders and rule matches always, a WAF or IPS source only if it has not been collected yet. Nothing old raises an alert. A Yes is never reversed; reading can be stopped.
confirm.no: This records No. No history is read. You can still choose Read history now later.
confirm.start: This asks every family to read history again at its next collection: source volume, catch-all senders and rule matches, including sources added since, and a WAF or IPS source only if it has not been collected yet. Nothing is read at once and nothing old raises an alert.
confirm.stop: This ends every scope that is reading as Partial, with the reason "stopped by" and your name. What was read stays and is used for learning. Nothing is deleted. Read history now starts it again.

dialog.questionDays: Read the last {days} days from QRadar?
dialog.question: Read QRadar's past?
dialog.region: What would be read, and what it costs
dialog.estimateFailed: The estimate could not be loaded.
dialog.estimateFailedHelp: Nothing was changed, and no answer can be recorded without it. Check that the backend is reachable, then try again, or decide later from History backfill in Administration.
dialog.caption: Families read from {name}, their state, and the estimate for each.
dialog.modelNote: These are estimates from a model, not measurements. Each family lists what it assumes.
dialog.nothingOld: Nothing old raises an alert. Old data is used for learning only; it is never judged.
dialog.costUnknown: This sends read-only searches to QRadar; how long it takes is not estimated. The schedule you set in Search cadence still applies.
dialog.cost: This sends read-only searches to QRadar for about {hours} hours; the schedule you set in Search cadence still applies.
dialog.alreadyCollected: WAF and IPS sources that already collected cannot read history; sources you enable from now on will. Property watches ask for history when you create the watch.
dialog.meantime: Your answer was not recorded. A decision was recorded in the meantime.
dialog.forbidden: Nothing was changed. Your role cannot record the answer (permission {permission}).
dialog.failed: Nothing was changed. The answer could not be recorded. Check that the backend is reachable, then try again.
dialog.errorTitle: The history backfill status could not be loaded
dialog.errorLead: Whether QRadar's past should be read is not known yet.
dialog.errorHelp: Nothing was changed. Check that the backend is reachable, then try again. The question is asked again at your next page load.
